content.lead: After this unit you will be able to:
items: order food and drink politely with Ich hätte gern … and Ich möchte …;
ask what there is (Was gibt es?) and say what you do not eat or drink (kein, keine);
reserve a table, ask for the bill and say how you want to pay;
use the accusative with ein and kein, and give prices in euros;
check the grammar of units 1 to 5.
